Bandizip_PluginDesc: Bandizip integration plugin. Lets Lertaro fill in the destination path in Bandizip's extract dialog and its add-files dialog (e.g. from the Quick Navigation menu).
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BandizipExtractDialogAd: Detects Bandizip's "choose extract path" dialog by its control structure (not window title, since Bandizip is localized) and lets Lertaro fill in its destination path field.
Plugin_Comp_Desc_BandizipAddFilesDialogA: Detects Bandizip's "choose files to add" dialog by its control structure (not window title, since Bandizip is localized) and lets Lertaro navigate it to a target folder.
